name: Tattoo Kit
body:
Tattoo Kit: This kit contains steel needles and ink for the purpose of making tattoos. Without such a kit, the tattoo artist must use improvised tools (-2 penalty to Craft checks). A kit contains enough ink for 2 medium tattoos.

Cost 25 gp. Ink refill 5 gp.
